svg.title: nca runs its issue course
svg.desc: A looping run, no script. The runner jumps five monsters in turn, one per shipped change: #11 regex picker search, #20 Alibaba DashScope, #73 dynamic installer, #74 word shortcuts in the prompt and #75 Keenable search. Each monster is squashed and turns mint with a check once it ships, and the counter reads 0/5 to 5/5 before the run restarts.
